why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Update the MyDoge app on iOS or Android and open The Grand Heist, or open quest.dogeos.com in a browser. Stick to the official app stores and to addresses ending in dogeos.com.
For testnet quests, add the DogeOS Chikyu Testnet to your wallet and claim free test DOGE from the faucet . The docs allow 42.069 test DOGE a day.
Do the quests in order and connect the social accounts each one asks for. If a quest doesn't verify, the FAQ says: "Wait 10 minutes, then try verifying again."
Come back for each new chapter, and spend your tickets on the Wheel of Doge . It signs in with your MyDoge wallet, where the tickets are kept.
costs: Nothing published asks for a payment. Test DOGE is free, and testnet fees are paid in it. The FAQ suggests that some on-chain quests have minimum amounts, and it warns: "Don't repeat a paid transaction just because verification is delayed." You also pay in personal data. risks: You must be at least 18. The terms bar anyone in "any jurisdiction subject to comprehensive sanctions or restrictions under applicable law" and name no countries. DogeOS can disqualify you "in its sole discretion" for bots, multiple accounts and similar abuse, and the terms let it "cancel or revoke rewards".
